title: Spicy BBQ Chicken Tikka
steps: Make deep cuts in the chicken pieces to allow the marinade to penetrate.
Mix yogurt, tikka masala, lemon juice, ginger garlic paste, and Kashmiri chili in a bowl.
Coat the chicken thoroughly with the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, overnight is best.
Preheat a charcoal grill or an oven to 200°C (400°F).
Grill the chicken for 15-20 minutes per side, basting occasionally with melted butter.
Serve hot with mint chutney and fresh onion rings.
